name: daedabyte-ad-pipeline
purpose: Generate one on-brand social ad per weekday for Daedabyte, hold it for human review, and schedule approved posts to Buffer.
goals: Five posts a week with Joe's effort limited to reviewing, giving feedback, and approving.
Every image is rendered from a fixed HTML template so brand colors, fonts, and layout never drift.
Claude writes copy and art-directs; it never draws pixels.
Nothing posts without an explicit approval click.

Every manual step (previewing templates, capturing a site, generating, revising, approving, test publishing, cleaning up test posts) is run and checked from the dashboard. The CLI exists for scheduled automation, not for day-to-day testing.
Single-tenant now, but every record carries an orgId so multi-tenant is additive later.
nonGoals: Generative image models in the core path (backgrounds only, behind a flag).
Analytics, comment replies, or DM handling.
Video or carousel posts in v0.

inputs.calendar: data/calendar.json (written by the plan step; edited in the dashboard, not by hand)

anthropic.use: copy, art direction, template selection, crop selection, revisions
anthropic.notes: Check docs.claude.com for the current model string and image-input format before coding. Return strict JSON; no prose.

buffer.use: create scheduled post (images by public URL; the current API has no upload endpoint), delete post
buffer.rateLimitNote: Plan shows ~7,500 requests/month and ~250/day. Budget: under 60 requests/week.
buffer.notes: Read the current Buffer API docs at buffer.com/developers before coding. Do not use old v1 (api.bufferapp.com) client libraries.

email.local: console log or Ethereal test inbox

architecture.packaging: single repo, src/ modules, one CLI entrypoint

storage.prod: DynamoDB or Postgres; same repository interface

capture.does: Load a site recipe, dismiss banners, wait for selectors, capture desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) PNGs for each named section.
capture.input: sites/<slug>.json (created and edited from the dashboard Sites page)

plan.does: Ask Claude for the week: one template + subject (+ optional site) per weekday, given brand.json, the sites (kind, captured sections) and recent drafts. Rules: vary templates, quote only with a captured testimonials section, screenshot only with a captured site. Reviewer edits the plan in the dashboard before generation.

generate.does: Build one Claude call per post: brand voice + brand.json + template slot schema + screenshots as images. Parse strict JSON. Validate against template slots. Insert a draft.

render.does: Fill templates/<template>.html with draft JSON, set CSS vars from brand.json, screenshot at 1080x1080 and 1080x1350.

revise.does: Replay the original generate messages plus the reviewer feedback as a follow-up turn. Re-render. Bump draft version.

publish.does: Serve the renders at PUBLIC_BASE_URL (Buffer fetches images by URL), create a scheduled Buffer post per channel with the platform-specific caption, store Buffer post IDs.
publish.guard: Only runs on status=approved. In TEST_MODE schedules 60 days out and logs the delete command.

dashboard.does: Express app on localhost:3000. Lists pending drafts with image, captions per platform, crop region overlay. Buttons: approve, revise (textarea), reject. Also the operator console for testing: template previews from fixtures, run capture for a site, run the weekly generation, publish an approved draft in test mode, and delete test posts from Buffer. Long jobs show progress and logs in the page.
dashboard.growth: A minimal shell ships in M2 and gains one page per milestone, so each milestone is checked in the UI rather than from the terminal.

notify.does: After a weekly run, send one digest with thumbnails and a link to the dashboard. Always written to data/digests/<weekOf>.html and viewable at /digest/<weekOf>; emailed with nodemailer when SMTP_URL and DIGEST_TO are set (Ethereal locally, SES SMTP in prod). nodemailer is the one dependency beyond the original list.

commands.weekly: capture -> generate -> render for the week's calendar
commands.revise <draftId> \"feedback\": revise from the CLI without the dashboard

drafts.contentJson: slot values + captions per platform + hashtags + crop
drafts.generationContext: JSON: plan day + messages sent to Claude (images stored as {type:image_ref,file} markers, reloaded on replay) + every request/response/cost

sites.name: string
sites.kind: own|client (own = Daedabyte's site: first-person copy, never presented as a client)
sites.recipe: JSON: dismiss selectors, waitFor selectors, sections[{name, selector}]

weeklyRun: Plan next week with Claude unless data/calendar.json already covers it: five slots, each with template, subject and optional site.
Capture screenshots for any site referenced this week (skip if cached under 7 days).

claudeContract.systemPrompt: brand.json (name, tagline, colors, fonts, voice rules, proof points, CTAs, hashtags, platforms) + template slot schema + the calendar slot's subject
claudeContract.userContent: screenshots as image inputs (max 6) + manifest describing each + any prior feedback

responseSchema.slots: object keyed by that template's slot names

crop.region: [x, y, w, h] in source pixels or null

responseSchema.rationale: one sentence, shown in the dashboard

validation: every slot for that template must be present and non-empty
headline word count within brand.json.voice.headlineWords, applied to screenshot.headline, stat.claim, and list.verdict
googlebusiness caption has no hashtags and no 'link in bio'
crop region must fall inside the screenshot's dimensions

templates.contract: Each file is self-contained HTML+CSS. Slot values are injected into data-slot attributes. Colors and fonts come from CSS variables set at render time from brand.json. Icon is an inline SVG from brand/assets/icon.svg. Fonts are loaded locally from brand/assets/fonts/ so rendering is deterministic.

required: PUBLIC_BASE_URL (for publishing: where Buffer can fetch renders)

guardrails: No code path posts to Buffer from a draft that is not status=approved.
TEST_MODE defaults to true until explicitly flipped.
brand.json.platforms[*].templates and maxPerWeek limit which drafts default to a platform (Google Business: stat and list only, twice a week); the reviewer can override per draft at publish time.
Client names appear in copy only when sites.<slug>.permissionToName is true.
Sites with kind=own are Daedabyte's own: copy speaks in the first person and never calls them a client or attaches client proof points to them.
Every Claude request and response is stored on the draft for replay and audit.
Cost per draft is logged; the weekly run aborts if projected cost exceeds COST_CEILING_USD (default 2.00).

milestones.name: Templates render
milestones.done: All four templates render from hard-coded JSON and visually match brand/examples/.

milestones.name: Capture works
milestones.done: One client site captured desktop and mobile with a recipe; banners dismissed; manifest written. Triggered and reviewed from the dashboard shell, which also shows the M1 template previews.

milestones.name: Generate + render end to end
milestones.done: Running the weekly job from the dashboard produces five pending drafts with renders and valid JSON (`npm run weekly` does the same for automation).

milestones.name: Dashboard + revise
milestones.done: Approve, revise, reject work; a revision produces a new version and the old one is still viewable.

milestones.name: Publish in test mode
milestones.done: An approved draft is test-published from the dashboard, appears in Buffer's queue 60 days out on all four channels, then is deleted from the dashboard (the delete command is still logged).

milestones.name: Partner demo
milestones.done: Digest email, dashboard walkthrough, one revision, one approval, post visible in Buffer.

laterAws.trigger: EventBridge weekly rule -> Lambda or Fargate task running `weekly`
laterAws.storage: S3 for assets, DynamoDB for drafts/runs
laterAws.dashboard: Lambda + API Gateway or a small Fargate service behind Cognito
